hypothesis: After aggressive demand removes at least half of the displayed ask depth, rapid same-price replenishment by at least the swept quantity identifies latent supply and predicts a short-horizon reversal in the directly quoted complementary token.

signal.aggressor_side: a print at or above the already-received direct ask; published last_trade_price.side is audit-only and an in-spread or otherwise unknown direction fails closed
signal.decision_time: the immutable qualify receipt plus exactly 250 milliseconds, whether refill evidence arrives earlier or not

causality.trade_direction: infer from the print price against the already-received direct bid and ask; never trust the undocumented last_trade_price.side field
causality.equal_receipt_batches: apply atomically before a decision due at the same receipt time
causality.disconnect: clear all books, burst state, watches, trade-silence state and connection coverage; require fresh full snapshots
causality.sequence_gap_crossed_book_or_stale_state: fail closed and permanently taint the market

execution.limit: the highest direct complementary ask required to fill five shares at the frozen decision, unchanged afterward
execution.partial_fills: retain every positive fill in risk and PnL; only full five-share entries advance stopping
execution.fee_rounding: each leg fee is rounded to five decimals using half-up
execution.unwind: sell the acquired direct token across direct bids after the same evaluation latency; hold any unsold residual to settlement

controls.no_refill: same qualifying burst and depletion, but no full refill by the immutable 250 millisecond decision
controls.direction_reversal: for every base decision, buy the directly quoted swept token using its own five-share frozen limit
controls.time_shift: for every base decision, preserve the original complementary side and limit but make the decision exactly 5000 milliseconds later only if five shares remain executable
controls.quote_add_no_trade: a separate cohort with at least five cumulative same-token ask shares added inside a fully observed 250 millisecond window, no same-token trade in that window and no same-receipt dual-token ambiguity
controls.shared_execution: all treatment and control rows use the same receipt clock, direct books, five-share target, fixed-limit FAK replay, exact fees, five-second unwind and residual settlement

statistics.exact_test: one-sided exact binomial sign test on positive versus non-positive resolved full-entry PnL
statistics.stopping_clock: the earliest common base decision receipt timestamp at which both 400 and 500 millisecond arms independently have 1000 resolved full five-share entries across at least seven UTC days
statistics.partial_fills: included in variant risk, PnL and EV reporting but excluded from primary stopping counts
